[ext-v1] Revision of the previously rejected draft. ONLY substantive change: added ext.entity.industry_code on the subject from CONTRACT_NAME via the reviewed anzsic_dewr_program crosswalk with scheme anzsic2006, exactly as the reviewer requested. The four approved address.* rules (indices 2-5) are moved to the establishment role via base_rule_edits because the address describes the service site, not the business; entity.trading_name and entity.website stay on the subject. CONTRACT_NAME is legitimately mapped twice to two different concepts: the programme delivered at the site (ext.establishment.program, on the establishment) and the provider's activity evidence (ext.entity.industry_code, on the subject). Caveat for review: anzsic_dewr_program entries flagged verified=false should be checked against DEWR's official programme list; the rule emits no ANZSIC code of its own.

It identifies the office across snapshots and is not a business registration identifier.

fields.reason: SITE_ADDRESS_LN is the street line of the provider's service site; mapped to address.full on the establishment role, which matches the premises. Placeholder nulling is sensible; held-out values ('2nd Floor 22 East Row', 'Level 1 42 Katherine Terrace', 'Ang Gnarra Co-Op Peninsula Development Road') pass through intact.
SITE_LOCALITY_NAME is the suburb/town of the site address (CANBERRA, WAGGA WAGGA, KATHERINE, LAURA, KATOOMBA). Correctly establishment-scoped locality; mixed case variants preserved as published.
SITE_STATE_CD is an explicit AU state code column (ACT, NSW, NT, QLD, VIC, SA), matching the address.state enum directly; no inference used.
SITE_POSTCODE is the site's postcode; 3-digit NT value 850 re-padded to 0850 is correct for NT and matches the site's state, so the padding is not a guess.

CONTRACT_NAME is the government programme/contract code delivered at the site (DESB, DESA, RJCP, TTW5, EPS5, NEI5, HLS5, SPP5), not a source-stated activity of the provider. Using it to derive ext.entity.industry_code asserts that each provider's ANZSIC activity is determined by which contract it holds, which is not evidence of trade class. The crosswalk is self-described as unreviewed draft ('review_status: draft, entries marked verified false'), there are no publisher_evidence items, derivation level L2 is insufficient for crosswalk_required, and the ontology requires the raw source value in raw_value with a reviewed table. The inconsistent output in the held-out data (HLS5 -> 7211 'Employment Placement and Recruitment Services' in most rows but 7212 'Labour Supply Services' for the Sarina Russo HLS5 site) shows the mapping is not deterministic evidence but an artefact of the draft table. This same column is already emitted correctly as ext.establishment.program (rule 6); industry_code should be dropped.

DIS_SITE_CODE is the publisher's site code, stable across snapshots and unique per site/contract row; appropriate for ext.establishment.source_key and correctly not treated as a business registration identifier.

CONTRACT_NAME is exactly the government programme/contract code delivered at the site; ext.establishment.program matches the ontology note and multi-valued semantics (one value per row/site-contract), correctly establishment-scoped rather than business-scoped.

ESA_CD_1 values (5ACT, 4SOE, 5ORA, NTKR, 5HNB, 5MEE, QCOK, 5ADN, 5SYN, 5CTW, 4HAS) are Employment Services Area codes — precisely the 'employment services area' example the ontology gives for ext.establishment.region. Establishment role and multi-valued cardinality fit.

LATITUDE/LONGITUDE are published decimal degrees inside Australia; geo_point emits 'lat,lon' per ontology. The RM30 row's literal NULL yields no geo observation, as required (NULL is missing, not a point).

Only the domain of the published site email is stored (visionaustralia.org, bec.net.au, aep.salvationarmy.org), so the personal local part is never emitted; entity_role establishment attached to a site-published address is acceptable.

role_email may only emit role mailboxes; the held-out raw values were redacted as '<personal>@...', so no role_email observation appears, which is consistent with dropping personal mailboxes. But the rule is stated as if DEWR sites publish enquiries@/info@ addresses and no such value is visible in any held-out record — the survival of this rule on non-redacted data is unverified. Keep only if role mailboxes genuinely occur; otherwise personal mailboxes silently produce nothing.

SITE_CONTACT_PHONE is a business line published for the office; qualifier role=site_contact, E.164 with state-derived area code (+612..., +617..., +618...) is correct, and 13/1800 numbers (131559, 1800466046) are preserved as published business lines, not personal mobiles.
PHONE_NUMBER is the provider office's landline; role=office qualifier is accurate, normalisation with state area code is sound, and blank/truncated values are dropped. No personal mobile is emitted.
AGENT_FREECALL_NUM contains 13/1300/1800 national freecall lines (1800466046, 131559, 136123); role=freecall qualifier fits and they are complete national numbers unaffected by state completion.

SITE_URL is the provider's published site website; url_domain yields the registrable host and strips scheme/www (novaemployment.com.au from http://www..., visionaustralia.org.au from www...). Blank SITE_URL rows correctly yield no observation.

critic.summary: The address, state, postcode, geo, source_key, program, region and contact-phone/website rules are sound and correctly establishment-scoped; NT 3-digit postcodes re-padded to 0850 and NULL geo handled properly, and no personal mailbox or mobile is emitted. The one clear failure is rule 4: CONTRACT_NAME is a government programme code, not evidence of the provider's ANZSIC activity, and it is pushed through an unreviewed draft crosswalk with no publisher evidence, producing inconsistent codes (HLS5 -> 7211 vs 7212). Drop it — the same column is already correctly mapped as ext.establishment.program. Rule 10 (role_email) is doubtful because no surviving role mailbox is demonstrable in the held-out records; all other held-out rows contain only personal local parts. No important unmapped columns were found (LOCATION_NAME duplicates SITE_LOCALITY_NAME; ESA_CD_2/3 and column_18 are empty).

SITE_LOCALITY_NAME is the suburb/town of the site and matches address.locality; held-out values are real AU localities.
SITE_STATE_CD is an explicit AU state code column; held-out values NSW/ACT/QLD/NT/SA/VIC all map cleanly to the enum. No guessing.
SITE_POSTCODE is a postcode column; the three-digit NT value (850) is re-padded to 0850, which is correct for NT postcodes. All other held-out values are valid 4-digit AU postcodes.

DIS_SITE_CODE is the publisher's site code; it identifies the establishment site across snapshots and is correctly not presented as a business registration identifier. Note it is not unique per row (A300 appears for two contracts), which the grain rationale already acknowledges, so this is acceptable for a site key.
CONTRACT_NAME holds DEWR contract codes (DESB, DESA, NEI5, RJCP, HLS5, TTW5, EPS5) delivered at the site, matching ext.establishment.program. It is a site attribute, not a business identifier.

ESA_CD_1 is the Employment Services Area code (5ACT, 4SOE, 5ORA, NTKR, QCOK, 5HNB, 5MEE, 5SYN, 5CTW, 5ADN, 4HAS), which the ontology explicitly lists as an example of a publisher region for an establishment. Correctly multi-valued target is emitted one value per row.

LATITUDE/LONGITUDE joined as 'lat,lon' matches ext.establishment.geo; the literal NULL row (RM30) correctly produces no geo observation, and the remaining coordinates are plausible Australian decimal degrees.

Only the domain of SITE_EMAIL_ADDRESS is emitted; the personal local part is discarded. Held-out domains (visionaustralia.org, iim.net.au, bec.net.au) are correct registrable hosts. The establishment grain role is acceptable since the mailbox is the site's contact.

role_email keeps only role mailboxes via the transform, so personal mailboxes are dropped. In the held-out records all site emails are personal, and indeed no role_email observations were emitted — consistent behaviour, not an error.

SITE_CONTACT_PHONE is genuinely the site contact line and area completion from state is reasonable, but the name is misleading: in held-out data it frequently equals PHONE_NUMBER exactly (A230, AB00, BK20, RM30, WQ65, UGKZ, WG35, N023) and in A300/G150 it equals the freecall/13-number rather than a distinct site line. Emitting the same E.164 number twice under roles 'site_contact' and 'office' creates duplicate multi-valued observations for one number; the two source columns should be de-duplicated or one role dropped.

PHONE_NUMBER is the provider office line; the mapping is defensible, but it duplicates SITE_CONTACT_PHONE in most held-out rows, and in WC05 the only phone emitted is this one while SITE_CONTACT_PHONE (136123) was dropped by phone_au — so identical numbers are recorded twice under different roles (A230 +61261325800 appears as both site_contact and office). Duplicate values per establishment weaken the multi-valued phone claim.

AGENT_FREECALL_NUM is a freecall line mapped as a business line under role 'freecall', which is acceptable in principle, but in held-out data it duplicates SITE_CONTACT_PHONE/SITE_CONTACT_PHONE values exactly (A300 and A290: 1800466046 emitted as both site_contact and freecall). Emitting the same number under two roles again implies duplicate observations; also 'AGENT' freecall on some rows may be the agent's line rather than the site's, and no evidence distinguishes them.

SITE_URL reduced to registrable domain matches ext.contact.website_domain (www. and scheme stripped: http://www.novaemployment.com.au -> novaemployment.com.au). Empty SITE_URL rows correctly yield no observation.
